definitions.explanation: The place where one was born and raised, or where one's family roots are. A somewhat formal or literary word for one's home region.

examples.japanese: {郷里|きょうり}を{離|はな}れてもう{二十年|にじゅうねん}になる。
examples.english: It's been twenty years since I left my hometown.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}は{郷里|きょうり}に{戻|もど}って、のんびり{暮|く}らしたいと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to go back to my hometown and live a relaxed life.

notes: A formal or literary synonym of {故郷|ふるさと}/{故郷|こきょう}. In everyday conversation, {地元|じもと} (local area) or {実家|じっか} (parents' home) are more commonly used. {郷里|きょうり} often appears in written language, biographical profiles, and formal introductions. Common collocations include {郷里|きょうり}に{帰|かえ}る (to return to one's hometown) and {郷里|きょうり}を{離|はな}れる (to leave one's hometown).
